title: Tablet to Dr. Auguste Forel
textType: Authoritative text and recorded talk of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá

attributionNote: Tablet to Dr. Auguste Forel, by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá shelf.
description: A letter written by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá in 1921 in reply to a letter from Professor Auguste Forel, a Swiss psychiatrist. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
